the SFM-based media are the best media to maintain corneal cell viability.
the use of SFM-based media is the best way to support the viability of human cornea cells in the described in vitro system.
the use of SFM is the best choice for maintaining viability of human corneals in culture, especially in the presence of deswelling agents.

the choice of the deswelling agent is critical for maintaining corneal cell viability.
